entries.estimatedFrom: Tax Foundation Local Income Taxes in 2023 and the 92N state-local fiscal-authority matrix. The most common matrix rule supplies unread jurisdictions. Wage-income, employer-payroll and head-tax categories remain distinct.
entries.replacement: Replace the secondary classification with each county's first-party wage-income authority, caps and resident/nonresident rules. Actual adopted rates and saved paid wages remain necessary; no income, payment or county government is invented.

entries.estimatedFrom: IRS corporate tax practice and recorded business-owner relationships. Completed company receipts less completed wages remain an incomplete operating-income estimate; nonpay costs and deductions are not invented.
entries.replacement: Use recorded corporate form and complete taxable books when available. The company pays from its own cash; owner exposure represents a company cost, never a personal distribution or ownership-share allocation.

entries.estimatedFrom: ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE: modal selective-excise legislative authority in the 34 compiled constitutional tax-power rows; FHWA road usage charge program practice and NCSL State Fiscal Policy. Local voter steps and constitutional limits remain those of the governing rule pack.
entries.replaceWhen: The local constitutional and organic-act authority, including voter requirements and exceptions, is compiled for each estimated place.

entries.estimatedFrom: HUD FY2025 income limits (24 CFR 982.201) and Census CPS Table H-8, 2023 household income. ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE: state HUD areas represent unread local areas; unread jurisdictions use the median of the 50 compiled HUD state limits and 51 CPS household medians. Missing household income is estimated, never recorded as wages or zero.
entries.replacement: Use recorded household income and local HUD limits when available. Immigration and asset qualification remain outside this income-scoped entitlement; no enrollment, appropriation or payment is inferred.
